sections.title: Early spring flowers and later leaves
sections.text: Coltsfoot is a rhizomatous perennial. Its yellow, dandelion-like flower heads rise on scaly stems before the broad, heart-shaped leaves appear; leaves commonly reach about 5–18 cm across. The plate shows this unusual sequence.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Coltsfoot contains pyrrolizidine alkaloids that can injure the liver; medicinal use is not a basis for treating it as safe to eat or brew. Avoid ingestion, especially of unverified preparations.
